description: Known Koopman eigenfunctions of this system, as data: exact expressions in its state, parameter and dimensionless-group names, with the conditions under which they hold.

eigenfunctions.title: Energy H = v^2/2 - alpha x^2/2 + beta x^4/4
eigenfunctions.derivation: conserved by the configured field: eigenvalue 0

eigenfunctions.title: Outer-orbit phase exp(i phi)
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero damping and driver; outer orbits H > 0
eigenfunctions.derivation: x = A cn(sqrt(D) t|m) solves x'' = alpha x - beta x^3; phase inverted through atan2(sn, cn)

eigenfunctions.title: Single-well phase exp(i phi)
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero damping and driver; inner orbits -alpha^2/(4 beta) < H < 0, either well
eigenfunctions.derivation: x = s A dn(nu t|m) solves x'' = alpha x - beta x^3; sn^2 = (1 - x^2/A^2)/m, sn cn = -s v/(A nu m)
